sources.brief:
A small community library needs an English-language web application to manage book loans and reduce manual loan records. Librarians can add and update book-copy records. Members can browse available copies, borrow an available copy, and view their own current loans. Librarians can record the return of a borrowed copy. The application must prevent a copy from having two active loans. A recorded return makes that copy available again.

The project team consists of a Product Owner, a Business Analyst, a Developer and a QA Engineer. The Business Analyst is Responsible for preparing the specification and the Product Owner is Accountable for its preparation. The Product Owner is both Responsible and Accountable for approving business requirements, accepting the specification, accepting user acceptance testing results, and making the release decision. The Developer is both Responsible and Accountable for implementation and deployment. The QA Engineer is both Responsible and Accountable for test preparation and execution. A library representative explains library workflows and participates in user acceptance testing as a project adviser.
